what: blaze_sim::control matches `says` against the first failing case only (shrink_runs 0), so a plant that can trip two oracle checks (blaze-expansion ModuleOutOfKey: stale output or answered-without-run) cannot name one message without a guess at which check fires first; porting writers must reason about check order or pass an empty needle. A list of accepted messages, or matching any failing case, would let every control say what it catches.
